brief: Webinar stack for online courses — landing, registration, live tool, replay, email follow-up, payment.

slots.tagline: Framer turns ideas into high-converting landing pages without writing a single line of code.
slots.f1Body: Drag elements onto a responsive canvas and ship pages in minutes.
slots.f2Body: Update webinar copy, speaker bios, and agendas from one dashboard.
slots.f3Body: Push your landing page live to a global CDN with one click.

slots.tagline: Calendly captures sign-ups and sends calendar invites while you focus on content.
slots.f1Body: Route free and paid guests to the correct webinar session automatically.
slots.f2Body: Send email and SMS reminders that cut no-shows dramatically before showtime.
slots.f3Body: Embed a booking widget directly into your Framer page in seconds.

slots.tagline: YouTube Live handles HD streaming, chat moderation, and unlimited audience scale for free.
slots.f1Body: Stream crisp video to thousands of attendees without bandwidth worries.
slots.f2Body: Moderate questions and engage viewers using native live chat tools.
slots.f3Body: Every broadcast is saved as a replay-ready file automatically after ending.

slots.tagline: Loom packages your replay into a gated, trackable experience that converts lurkers into buyers.
slots.f1Body: Trim silence, add chapter markers, and insert CTAs inside the browser.
slots.f2Body: Track exactly who watched, skipped ahead, or replayed key moments.
slots.f3Body: Share password-protected links so only paying members access replays.

slots.tagline: n8n wires your stack together so no lead falls through the cracks post-webinar.
slots.f1Body: Build complex automations by dragging nodes together without code.
slots.f2Body: Trigger emails when replays are watched or payments are received.
slots.f3Body: Host on your own server to keep all student data private.

slots.tagline: Stripe collects one-time or recurring revenue and deposits it straight to your bank.
slots.f1Body: Accept cards, Apple Pay, and local methods across 135 currencies.
slots.f2Body: Generate tax-compliant receipts and invoices with zero manual effort.
slots.f3Body: Unlock course access and start email sequences immediately after purchase.

slots.ctaBody: Clone this exact webinar stack and start taking paid registrations in under an hour.
